decisions.notes: The packet evidence for this row is wrong: it cites the June 2026 power-generating-facility articles, which belong to mi-lima-township-2026. I substituted primary synopses. The 12-8-25 board synopsis records Resolution 25-15 'placing a temporary moratorium on approval of data centers' (all ayes). Sun Times News (2025-12-29) gives the 180-day term. The 7-13-26 synopsis records 'Resolution 2026-13 Extending the Temporary Moratorium on Approval of Data Centers' (all ayes). Caveat: 180 days from 2025-12-08 is about 2026-06-06, so the July 13 'extension' came after the nominal lapse unless the attorney-reviewed text set a later start; treat 'extended' as the township's own label. The 2026-08-10 zoning amendment only adds general moratorium authority, not data-center regulations, so it does not end the moratorium.

decisions.notes: Row date is right and MLive's is wrong. Minutes show introduction/first reading of Ordinance 67-U on 2026-02-09, a second introduction/first reading at a 2026-03-23 special meeting, and adoption at second reading on 2026-03-26 (special meeting, 4 yes). MLive's 'adopted Feb. 9' is a first-reading date. 67-U is a zoning-ordinance amendment, but its content is a one-year moratorium, a temporary pause rather than a permanent rule.
